description: Supplement of the interface-sizes vocabulary: the size keys the console, handheld, controller, cable, power-adapter and game-media standard parts need (USB, HDMI, D-sub, audio, RF and DC power connectors, IEC 60320 couplers, AA and AAA cells, SD cards, optical discs, the UMD cartridge, arcade pushbuttons) and the base file did not define. Same rules as the base: two interfaces mate only when their resolved size keys are EQUAL, and every dimension cites a public standard or manufacturer source. Merged into interface-sizes when the vocabulary is loaded.

review.note: Keys, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01). No language facet has had a native review; Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were read from the cited sources on the access date.
